name: Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A.
summary: Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A., through its subsidiaries, engages in the sanitation business in Chile. The company operates through Water and Non-Water segments. The Water Utility segment production and distribution of drinking water; and collects and treats sewage water. The Non-Water segment is involved in e industrial waste treatment, comprehensive industrial waste, engineering services, energy projects, and biogas. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Las Condes, Chile. Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Suez Inversiones Aguas del Gran Santiago Limitada.
